issues.description: Most examples describe poor or unavailable support in general terms, while one concerns disagreement with a price increase.
Customers report difficulty reaching support or getting useful, safe help to resolve app problems.
Examples vary between successful and unsuccessful support experiences, with one focused on difficulty unsubscribing.
The examples mix unresolved support cases and response praise with complaints about free service, spam, and subscription security.
Examples mix difficult or ineffective support with successful resolutions and unrelated playlist and account problems.
